summary: Shows updating task_vars in the debugger, which requires update_task before redo; notes vars was renamed task_vars in 2.5.
questions: How do I change a variable value in the debugger?
Why didn't changing task_vars take effect on redo?

answer_card.title: Updating task variables in the debugger
answer_card.answer_md:
```
(debug)> task_vars['pkg_name'] = 'bash'
(debug)> update_task
(debug)> redo
```

You must run **`update_task`** to load new variables before `redo`. (`vars` was renamed `task_vars` in 2.5.)
